label: 在 upperCanvas 上派发原生 dblclick
js: (() => { const up = document.querySelector('canvas.upper-canvas'); if (!up) return 'no-upper-canvas'; const b = up.getBoundingClientRect(); const x = b.left + 240, y = b.top + 220; const opts = { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, view: window, clientX: x, clientY: y, detail: 2, button: 0 }; up.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('dblclick', opts)); return 'dispatched@' + Math.round(x) + ',' + Math.round(y) })()
